The '''Bespin Direct StarSpeeder 1000''' was a modified [[StarSpeeder 1000]] [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]] used by the [[The galaxy/Legends|interstellar]] travel agency [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]], to operate flights bound for the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040930bespinmain|text=Bespin: Action Tidings|int=Bespin: Action Tidings}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]],<ref name="Playset" /> prior to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="STAC" /> The starship was painted in red and grey along with the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] letters [[Wesk/Legends|Wesk]], [[Dorn/Legends|Dorn]] and [[Isk/Legends|Isk]].<ref name="STSF" /> It was named after both the gas giant as well as [[Bespin Direct]], a separate spaceliner company from Star Tours that also was a member of the [[Galactic Tourist Bureau/Legends|Galactic Tourist Bureau]].

It was equipped with a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielding]] systems, two [[Flashcannon|flash cannon]]s and two [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]. The ship was crewed by a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], a green-[[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] and a [[systems analyst]].<ref name="Playset" /> The ship could support up to 40 passengers.<ref name="STAC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bespin Direct StarSpeeder 1000 was first introduced on [[The Walt Disney Company]] website in [[2011]] as a papercraft model.<ref name="STSF" /> The speeder was also released in the same year in a set of diecast toys, the StarSpeeder 1000 Spaceliner Collection.<ref name="Playset" />

According to a ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' poster sign, only Star Tours flew StarSpeeder 1000s, which confirms Star Tours ownership of this vessel.<ref name="EnEx">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' {{C|cf. {{EndorExpress|url=2011/06/star-tours-the-adventures-continue-june-3-2011/img_0659-2|text=IMG_0659|nobackup=1}}}}</ref> The Japanese version, however, indicated that it was part of a separate company which was affiliated with Star Tours via the [[Galactic Tourist Bureau/Legends|Galactic Tourist Bureau]].<ref name="TDLVideo">{{YouTube|video=VP1Ms45_fZ8|text=TDL : New STAR TOURS【Space Port 1138】. 新･スター･ツアーズ【スペース･ポート11３８】|channel=@couperin9|name=couperin9}}</ref>
